name: mcp-for-azure-devops-boards
description: MCP for Azure DevOps Boards is a MCP server that lets your favourite AI browse, query and update Azure DevOps work items as if it were a project manager. Written in Rust and optimized for tokens usagem, It runs via stdio or HTTP mode and uses standard Azure authentication with az login.
